main_text.l: ereor ne incassum laboret, atque oleum
& operam perdat; primò dicit MSS. Co-
lices multorum sæculorum in assignando
Decreti Autore plurimùm variare, quia
extat vetustissimus Codex Collectionis
Dionysianæ in quo Decretum hoc Dama-
so Papæ tribuitur; Codex Ecclesiæ
Vrgellensis,& Iurensis pervetustus ascribunt
Hormisdæ;Alij Gelasium Autorem agnos-
cunt; mira profectò varietas, sed mira-
bilius Viri docti Consilium, qui in rebus
nihili causæ quærit præsidium, ex infinitis
ut ita dicam Gelasiani Decreti MSS. Co-
dicibus, tres tantùm memorantur, qui in
assignando Decreti Autore variant, cæteri
magno consensu Gelasium Autorem
agnoscunt [illegible, ~1 letter]ùm igitur tres illi codices
qui variant in assignando Decreti Auto-
re, numero sint pauciores, nec alijs anti-
quitate præstare dicantur, quin potior
majórque debeat esse aliorum autoritas,
quàm trium dubitabit nemo cui sanum
erit finciput; Deinde si valet ista Viri doc-
ti ratiocinatio, quid fiet de plærísque

ibris? cùm varient sæpissimè codices in as-
signandis istorum librorum Autoribus;

tundam Codicum varietatem, vera ac ge-

page.notes: Left margin shows only fragments of the neighbouring page's edge (stray marks, "it", "js", "ed" and similar); not transcribed. The first word "ereor" is a fragment at the page edge; its first letter is cut off, so it stays a fragment. "lices" at the start of line 3 is also cut at the edge (probably "Codices"); copied as printed. The ink blot covers the first letter of "cùm" in "agnoscunt ... ùm"; marked illegible. "&ti" at the start of the line beginning "cti ratiocinatio" is partly cut off; uncertain, not marked here. The marginal note "P.carf." is in italic type.
